name: Pre-Tool-Use Formatter
description: Validates and formats input before any tool is invoked. Ensures data integrity and prevents malformed payloads from reaching downstream tools.
author: maradantaspereira-eng

name: Post-Tool-Use Logger
description: Captures tool execution results and writes structured logs for observability pipelines. Supports JSON and plaintext output formats.
author: maradantaspereira-eng

name: Pre-Commit Linter
description: Runs static analysis on staged files before committing. Blocks commits that fail linting rules, enforcing code quality standards across the repository.
author: maradantaspereira-eng

name: Session Start Banner
description: Displays a welcome banner and project context summary at the start of each Claude Code session. Helps orient the agent to current project state.
author: maradantaspereira-eng

name: Slack Notifier
description: Sends structured Slack messages when Claude Code triggers notification events. Configurable webhook URL and message templates via environment variables.
author: maradantaspereira-eng

name: Stop Auditor
description: Audits the final state of tool usage at session end. Generates a summary report of all tools invoked, commands run, and files modified during the session.
author: maradantaspereira-eng

name: Bash Command Guard
description: Intercepts Bash tool calls and blocks execution of potentially destructive commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, etc.). Prompts for confirmation on flagged patterns.
author: maradantaspereira-eng

name: File Edit Snapshot
description: Creates timestamped snapshots of files immediately after Edit or Write tool operations. Provides a lightweight rollback mechanism for local file changes.
author: maradantaspereira-eng
